== c2s_empty_vault ==
(ArmadaYieldVault.sol:491-494, origin/main 64436c14: the first deposit's pre-lock
share count is one-for-one with the deposited assets.)

== locked_shares_set_at_first_deposit ==
(ArmadaYieldVault.sol:74-81, 285-290, origin/main 64436c14, PR #631 04753139: after
a valid first deposit, total supply equals the deposited assets and exceeds
LOCKED_SHARES.)
'locked_shares_set_at_first_deposit' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

== locked_shares_supply_invariant ==
(ArmadaYieldVault.sol:74-81, 83-85, origin/main 64436c14: a burn bounded by the
non-locked balance keeps total supply at or above LOCKED_SHARES — the dead
LOCKED_SHARES_HOLDER never redeems.)
'locked_shares_supply_invariant' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]

(ArmadaYieldVault.sol:491-514, origin/main 64436c14: a deposit-then-redeem round
trip loses at most C / S + 1, the exact floor-division bound.)
'round_trip_loss_le' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

== donation_loss_bound ==
(ArmadaYieldVault.sol:74-81, 491-514, origin/main 64436c14: a depositor's rounding
loss from a donation X is at most X / LOCKED_SHARES + 2, sharper than the NatSpec's
`~` estimate.)

== donation_attack_unprofitable ==
(ArmadaYieldVault.sol:74-81, 491-514, origin/main 64436c14: a donation attacker
holding s < S shares out of total supply S recovers at most X + s.)

== donation_attack_unprofitable_post_fix ==
(ArmadaYieldVault.sol:74-85, origin/main 64436c14, PR #631 04753139:
donation_attack_unprofitable specialized to the fixed contract's own invariant

donation attack cannot profit, after
the fix.)
'donation_attack_unprofitable_post_fix' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

== fee_conservation ==
(ShieldModule.sol:353-371, audit C-3: the inclusive fee split is exact —
base + fee = amount. Branch pool-symbolic: the fee is a ratio (finding P-9). The
deployment sets it; only the fee admin changes it.)
'fee_conservation' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]

== fee_zero_below_threshold ==
(ShieldModule.sol:353-371, audit C-3: a shield with amount * num < den pays a zero
fee (amounts below 200 at 50/10000).)
'fee_zero_below_threshold' depends on axioms: [propext]
